# Words to avoid in prose

This list is our own. It is not the ASD-STE100 dictionary.

| Do not use | Use | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| "utilize" | use | W1.4 |
| "utilise" | use | W1.4 |
| "leverage" | use | W1.4 |
| "facilitate" | help, or let | W1.4 |
| "in order to" | to | W1.4 |
| "prior to" | before | W1.4 |
| "subsequent to" | after | W1.4 |
| "subsequently" | then, or after | W1.4 |
| "whilst" | while | W1.4 |
| "amongst" | among | W1.4 |
| "a number of" | some, or the number | W1.4 |
| "in the event that" | if | W1.4 |
| "due to the fact that" | because | W1.4 |
| "at this point in time" | now | W1.4 |
| "commence" | start | W1.4 |
| "endeavor" | try | W1.4 |
| "functionality" | function, or feature | W1.4 |
| "performant" | fast, with a number | W1.4 |
| "seamless" | the exact result | W1.4 |
| "seamlessly" | the exact result | W1.4 |
| "robust" | the exact property | W1.4 |
| "simply" | nothing: delete it | W1.4 |
| "just" | nothing: delete it, or only | W1.4 |
| "basically" | nothing: delete it | W1.4 |
| "obviously" | nothing: delete it | W1.4 |
| "clearly" | nothing: delete it | W1.4 |
| "actually" | nothing: delete it | W1.4 |
| "really" | nothing: delete it | W1.4 |
| "very" | a number, or a stronger word | W1.4 |
| "please note" | NOTE:, or nothing | W1.4 |
| "note that" | NOTE:, or nothing | W1.4 |
| "it should be noted" | nothing: state the fact | W1.4 |
| "as well as" | and | W1.4 |
| "and/or" | A, B, or both | W1.4 |
| "e.g." | for example | W1.4 |
| "i.e." | that is | W1.4 |
| "etc." | the full list | W1.4 |
| "in terms of" | about, or for | W1.4 |
| "with regard to" | about | W1.4 |
| "with respect to" | about | W1.4 |
| "a lot of" | many, or the number | W1.4 |
| "lots of" | many, or the number | W1.4 |
| "is able to" | can | W1.4 |
| "are able to" | can | W1.4 |
| "out of the box" | with no setup | W1.6 |
| "under the hood" | internally | W1.6 |
| "low-hanging fruit" | easy tasks | W1.6 |
| "on the fly" | while it runs | W1.6 |
| "silver bullet" | full solution | W1.6 |
| "boil the ocean" | do too much | W1.6 |
| "moving forward" | from now on | W1.6 |
| "kind of" | nothing, or a type of | W1.6 |
| "sort of" | nothing, or a type of | W1.6 |
| "perform a" | the verb alone, such as install | W3.4 |
| "perform an" | the verb alone, such as install | W3.4 |
| "carry out" | do, or the exact verb | W3.4 |
| "make use of" | use | W3.4 |
| "give consideration to" | consider | W3.4 |
| "make a decision" | decide | W3.4 |
| "take into account" | include | W3.4 |

## Hedges

Use 1 or fewer of these words in each sentence (W4.3):

- "may", "might", "could", "possibly", "probably", "perhaps", "likely", "unlikely"
- "seem", "seems", "seemed", "appear", "appears", "apparently", "somewhat", "fairly"
- "rather", "quite", "relatively", "potentially", "arguably", "presumably", "generally", "typically"
